original_test_intent: Have a trained operator perform the approved DC-cycle sequence repeatedly and prove each restore boots the intended SUT with unchanged Basic Health, passing Post-Boot Stress and no new lock, MCE/RAS or kernel error.
original_method: Resolve whether DC means physical PSU/connector removal or only S5 plus OOB power-on, approve a bounded 100-cycle plan and safe controller/operator path, preserve baseline logs, then for every operator-controlled transition reconcile power events and boot IDs, collect complete health/stress/RAS evidence and stop on the first abnormal or incomplete cycle.
manual_activity: A trained operator performs and records every approved DC action; the agent only collects post-restore machine evidence; the owner resolves semantics and decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Authoritative physical DC versus S5/IPMI sequence
Trained operator and safe PSU/connector/controller method
Basic Health/Post-Boot Stress and RAS/error criteria
Boot media, console/OOB recovery, maintenance and evidence storage
safety_requirements: Agent never performs physical DC control
Require trained operator, maintenance approval and verified recovery
Preserve logs and stable per-cycle evidence
Do not use ping alone as electrical/off-state proof
Stop after any abnormal power, boot, lock, health or RAS condition
Do not continue or retry failed cycles
agent_execution_scope: Observe and reconcile operator/OOB power events and boot IDs
Perform no physical toggle, semantic invention, recovery decision or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve DC versus S5/IPMI semantics and approve cycle/operator contract
Authorize physical work and safety/recovery thresholds
Disposition any failed/incomplete cycle and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The manual-only conclusion is correct for true physical DC, but the source itself describes S5 shutdown and IPMI power-on, so the owner must resolve scope before execution.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator performs the approved physical sequence; protected automation may only observe power/boot state and collect complete post-restore evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BIOS boot media, Basic Health baseline/per-cycle, S5/shutdown, IPMI power-on, Post-Boot Stress, dmesg/RAS, 100-cycle recommendation, no bundle and 60/2880-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each operator DC event to OOB telemetry, boot ID and complete health/stress/RAS results in an immutable cycle record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Clarifies the manual boundary and rejects destructive/insecure shortcuts without removing cycle coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: S5 plus ping loss is not proof that DC rails were removed, and IPMI power-on cannot by itself establish a physical DC restore.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated physical power removal can affect data integrity, PSU/hardware safety and recoverability.

project_override_considerations: If the intended case is only S5/off plus IPMI on, rename/clarify it through an approved decision rather than treating it as physical DC evidence. If true DC is required, physical/operator proof is mandatory.

Per-cycle operator identity, physical/OOB power timestamps and unique boot ID
Final reconciliation, no-clear/no-secret/no-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title requires DC cycling while the procedure only shuts down to S5 and sends IPMI power on; ping is not electrical-state proof, 100 cycles are merely recommended, logs are cleared and plaintext credentials are shown.

review_improvement: Retains the correct manual classification while exposing the source's power-state contradiction and defining a safe per-cycle evidence boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: S5 is a logical soft-off state and may retain standby rails, so it is not equivalent to physical DC removal. Loss of ping proves only network unreachability. Because the test identity hinges on electrical cycling, an agent cannot infer equivalence or operate the physical control. Each destructive cycle must be operator-owned, uniquely reconciled and stopped on first anomaly to preserve causality and safety.
